headline: The 5 best Pastel alternatives for agencies (2026)
standfirst: Pastel is a fast, honest feedback tool. The gap is usually the hours a person spends finding mistakes, canvas by canvas. Five options. One is ours. One is staying put.

superflowHeadline: Pastel is a feedback tool. Superflow is a feedback tool + a team.
superflowBody: The team is AI agents, built from your QA checklist. They check every site change and pin what they find. Your team decides. Your client approves from a link.
superflowBestFor: agencies where a senior person still checks every site by hand.

entries.name: BugHerd
entries.bestFor: agencies that want feedback pinned right on the live page, no proxy.
entries.standout: element pins with browser, OS, and screen size attached; built-in kanban; guests comment free from a link.
entries.limits: A person finds every issue. No AI. No memory concept; each project starts blank (checked July 2026). A formal client approval flow: not yet verified. Pricing: Standard $50 / Studio $80 / Premium $150 per month, plus $8 per member (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: Pins straight onto the live page instead of a proxy canvas. Pastel's Finish Review approval gate is confirmed on every plan, including Free; BugHerd's approval flow: not yet verified.

entries.name: Ruttl
entries.bestFor: the closest look-alike, with live-page edits included.
entries.standout: pixel-pinned comments plus an edit mode that changes text, images, and CSS on the live page, no code.
entries.limits: A person finds every issue. Ruttl AI is scoped to comment sentiment analysis and performance suggestions, not site checking. Whether clients can see private comments: not yet verified. Basic plan caps at 1 project, 5 pages, 10 comments, 1GB storage.
entries.vsAnchor: Adds an edit mode that changes text, images, and CSS on the live page. Pastel's canvas needs no extension on password-protected sites, through Browse mode; Ruttl needs its Chrome extension for the same job.

entries.name: Marker.io
entries.bestFor: dev teams that live in a tracker.
entries.standout: two-way tracker sync, so Done in Jira flips the issue to Resolved, plus console logs, network requests, and session replay on the Team plan.
entries.limits: A person finds every issue, then reports it. No free plan; Starter is $39 a month billed annually. A formal client approval flow: not yet verified. No Agency plan on marker.io's pricing page (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: Syncs two-way into a tracker; Pastel's exports are one-way and gated to its Team plan. Pastel's approval gate is confirmed on every plan; Marker.io's: not yet verified.

entries.name: Usersnap
entries.bestFor: product teams collecting user feedback, not agency client review.
entries.standout: two-way sync with Jira, Jira Product Discovery, Azure DevOps, and Linear, plus a public guest portal for upvoting.
entries.limits: Human-found only; AI only sorts feedback already submitted. A formal approve or reject gate: not yet verified. Pricing: free for 20 items, then Starter $49, Growth $109, Professional $189, Premium from $369 per month billed yearly (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: Built for end-user feedback and surveys, not client site review. Pastel's canvas covers the whole live site by URL; Usersnap needs a widget or browser extension installed first.

stayHeading: The sixth option: stay on Pastel
stayBody: No install on your live site: paste a URL, share one link, and the canvas updates itself when the site changes. The Finish Review approval gate ships on every plan, including Free. Every comment auto-captures a screenshot, plus browser type and screen size. Guest reviewers are unlimited on every plan, free (verified July 2026).
stayLine: If a careful human pass on a live site, plus a simple approve or request-changes sign-off, works for your studio, Pastel is a fast, low-friction fit. Stay.

faq.question: Which is the best Pastel alternative?
faq.answer: Depends which criterion fails you. If it's the checking hours, Superflow, the only one where the answer is a team, not a tool.

faq.question: Is Superflow just Pastel with AI?
faq.answer: No. Agents find the mistakes; a person makes every call.

faq.question: Can clients comment without an account?
faq.answer: On all of these, Pastel included, where guest reviewers are unlimited and free. In Superflow the client's yes is a recorded approval, not a comment.

faq.question: What does switching cost?
faq.answer: An afternoon. One snippet, or one click on Webflow, WordPress, GTM. Open canvases finish where they are.
